about: Hand-checked facts for the funding entries that matter most to K-State grad students. Each entry was read from the source page on the date in 'checked'. The matcher merges this file over data/student-opportunities.json at load time, so rebuilding the catalogue never erases it.

fields.needs: money | travel | research | software | everyday. Overrides the catalogue's category mapping.
fields.levels: Academic levels that can apply (Undergraduate, Master's, PhD). null means the source doesn't limit it.
fields.level_reason: Optional text shown when the chosen level is not in 'levels'.
fields.citizenship: us_only (citizens, nationals, permanent residents) | us_citizen_only (permanent residents excluded) | international_only | any | not_stated
fields.deadline: dates: ISO dates as published; labels: optional {date: label}; annual: MM-DD cycles the source lists without a year (shown as likely, never confirmed); rolling: true; detail: shown only while a date is upcoming; note: shown otherwise (closed, rolling, or not posted).
fields.exclude: Optional reason that rules the entry out for every current student.
fields.unit: Optional short tag for entries limited to one department, college, or degree (shown on the card, never used to exclude).

nsf-grfp.amount: $37,000 a year for 3 years, plus $16,000 a year to your school
nsf-grfp.who: STEM seniors, recent graduates, and first-year grad students.

labels.2026-10-23: Chemistry, geosciences, math, physics and astronomy

deadline.detail: Each field has its own deadline, Oct 19 to 23. Check yours.

check: You must have finished less than one academic year of grad school. Grad students get one try, in the first year of their first program.

doe-scgsr.amount: Supplemental funding for a 3 to 12 month stay at a DOE national lab
doe-scgsr.who: PhD students who want to do part of their thesis research at a DOE lab or facility.
check: You need proof of PhD candidacy in the application.

nih-f31.amount: Stipend plus tuition and fees support
nih-f31.who: PhD students in biomedical, behavioral, or clinical science, applying with a mentor.
check: You must be a citizen, national, or permanent resident by the time of award, not just when you apply.

usda-nifa-afri-predoctoral.amount: Up to $60,000 a year for up to 3 years (stipend capped at $35,000 a year)
usda-nifa-afri-predoctoral.who: PhD students in food and agriculture science doing dissertation research.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed Apr 16. The 2027 call isn't posted yet.

check: You must be advanced to candidacy by the deadline.

boren-fellowship.amount: Up to $25,000 for 25 to 52 weeks abroad, or $12,500 for 12 to 24 weeks
boren-fellowship.who: Grad students who want long-term study abroad and then a federal job.
check: You owe at least one year of federal service afterward.

daad-doctoral-programmes.title: DAAD Research Grants for Doctoral Candidates
daad-doctoral-programmes.amount: A 2 to 12 month research stay in Germany
daad-doctoral-programmes.who: Doctoral students who want to do part of their research at a German university or institute.

deadline.detail: Oct 31 is for projects starting the next June to September; Apr 30 for October or later.

check: Not a U.S. or Canadian citizen or permanent resident? You must live in the U.S. or Canada and your latest degree must be from there (a master's earned inside your PhD counts).
daad-doctoral-programmes.source_note: Checked on UChicago's graduate fellowships page because DAAD's own page did not load.

cgs-proquest-distinguished-dissertation-.who: Recent K-State PhD graduates in that year's rotating fields.

deadline.note: 2026 round closed. The 2026 fields were social sciences and engineering, math, and physical sciences.

check: Your program nominates you, and your degree date has to fall inside the award window.

sigma-xi-giar.amount: Grad students: up to $5,000 if you or your advisor are members, up to $1,000 if not
sigma-xi-giar.who: Students who need money for research costs.
check: About 75% of the money goes to members or students whose advisor is a member.

fems-research-training-grants.who: PhD students and microbiologists within 5 years of their last degree, for a research visit to a European lab.

deadline.note: Applications are closed. FEMS hasn't posted the next round.

check: You must belong to a FEMS member society.
The host lab must be in a European country other than the one you live in.

fems-meeting-attendance-grants.who: PhD students and microbiologists within 5 years of their last degree, presenting at a meeting anywhere.

deadline.detail: The Mar 1 round covers meetings from May 2027 to April 2028.

check: You must belong to a FEMS member society and be the presenting author.

grc-carl-storm-fellowship.amount: $1,250 toward a Gordon Research Conference (international version)
grc-carl-storm-fellowship.who: Grad students and postdocs from China, Africa, India, Central or South America, Russia, or Ukraine. A second version supports underrepresented minority scientists.

deadline.note: No fixed deadline. Limited money, first come, first served.

check: You can't apply yourself. The conference chair nominates you, so ask the chair.

deadline.note: The 2027 entry portal is up.

noster-science-microbiome-prize.exclude: You need a PhD or MD already, earned in the last 10 years. Students can't enter.

phi-kappa-phi-graduate-research-grant.who: Phi Kappa Phi members in grad school doing or presenting research between Jan 1 and Aug 31, 2027.
check: You must be a dues-paying member, or accept membership, by Nov 30, 2026.

gsc-travel-funding.amount: Up to $750 domestic or $1,000 international, one trip per fiscal year
gsc-travel-funding.who: K-State grad students going to an event. Presenting your own work gets priority.

deadline.note: Apply at least 21 days before the event. This round covers events starting through Jan 31, 2027.

check: You need a 3.0 GPA and at least 1 graduate credit hour, both when you apply and when you travel.

bgsa-travel-research-and-training-grants.who: Division of Biology grad students, for travel, research, or training costs.

deadline.note: No dates posted. Awards run June to June and depend on available funds.

check: Division of Biology grad students only.

bgsa-finishing-grants.who: Helps pay thesis or dissertation fees and other costs of finishing an MS or PhD in Biology.

deadline.note: Contact the BGSA treasurer before your defense.

check: You must be an active BGSA member when you defend.

arts-and-sciences-research-travel-awards.who: Arts and Sciences students presenting research, traveling to do research, or learning a technique.

deadline.note: Apply at least one month before the trip.

check: Your degree program must be in the College of Arts and Sciences.

k-state-sigma-xi-research-grants.level_reason: The K-State chapter award is for graduate students.
k-state-sigma-xi-research-grants.amount: $400 for one strong proposal the national round didn't fund
k-state-sigma-xi-research-grants.who: K-State grad students who also apply to Sigma Xi's national Grants in Aid of Research.
check: You or your faculty adviser must be a Sigma Xi member, and you send the same proposal to the national round.

kansas-water-institute-graduate-water-fe.amount: Up to $10,000 in matching support to the department that hosts you
kansas-water-institute-graduate-water-fe.who: Grad students with an advisor whose work fits the Kansas Water Institute's priorities.

deadline.note: No deadline posted. Send a request to water@ksu.edu.

check: Your research has to fit KWI's water priorities.

presidential-teaching-award-gta-category.title: Presidential Teaching Award (GTA category)
presidential-teaching-award-gta-category.who: One graduate teaching assistant a year, for undergraduate teaching.

deadline.note: Nominations open each spring.

check: Your department head nominates you. You can't apply directly.

marie-r-bonebrake-graduate-award.amount: $4,000 for the year, split between fall and spring
marie-r-bonebrake-graduate-award.who: On-campus grad students, judged on merit and financial need. The eligible college rotates.

deadline.note: 2026 nominations closed Sep 21.

check: Your college's associate dean nominates you. You can't apply directly.

timothy-r-donoghue-graduate-scholarship.level_reason: Only for students about to start a K-State grad program. Current grad students can't be nominated.
timothy-r-donoghue-graduate-scholarship.amount: $5,000 doctoral or $3,000 master's, renewable for a second year
timothy-r-donoghue-graduate-scholarship.who: Incoming K-State grad students with a half-time assistantship.

deadline.note: Nominations for Spring 2027 starts closed Oct 1.

check: Your future grad program nominates you. No self-nominations.

graduate-rscad-grant.amount: Up to $1,000 for direct research costs
graduate-rscad-grant.who: K-State master's and doctoral students with a faculty-supervised project.

deadline.note: The Spring 2026 round closed. 2026 to 2027 dates aren't posted yet.

check: You can get it only once during your K-State grad studies.

three-minute-thesis-competition.who: Explain your research in three minutes with one slide.

deadline.note: 2026 sign-ups closed Oct 6. First round Oct 28, final Jan 27, 2027.

sarachek-predoctoral-honors-fellowship.who: K-State doctoral candidates whose research leans on modern molecular biology methods.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed. The next date isn't posted.

check: You must have passed prelims and reached candidacy. Final-year students are encouraged, and you can nominate yourself.

k-state-alumni-international-leadership-.who: Recognizes four graduating international students for their impact on K-State's international community.

deadline.note: Alumni Association nominations are due in February or March.

check: For students who are graduating.

fulbright-us-student-program.who: A year abroad to study, research, or teach, for people with a bachelor's degree by the start of the grant.

deadline.note: The 2027 to 2028 competition is closed.

oip-scholarship-for-international-studen.who: International students who have finished at least one semester at K-State and are returning next year.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed Mar 17. No 2027 date posted yet.

check: One ISSS application covers these: two essays (campus involvement and financial need, no AI-written answers) and a K-State faculty or staff recommendation.

m-h-international-scholarship.who: International undergrad or grad students, including English Language Program students.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed Mar 17. No 2027 date posted yet.

check: One ISSS application covers these: two essays (campus involvement and financial need, no AI-written answers) and a K-State faculty or staff recommendation.

william-l-richter-international-scholars.who: International students in any K-State program. Preference for financial need and academic potential.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed Mar 17. No 2027 date posted yet.

check: One ISSS application covers these: two essays (campus involvement and financial need, no AI-written answers) and a K-State faculty or staff recommendation.

international-student-center-scholarship.who: Eight scholarships open to all international students.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed Mar 17. No 2027 date posted yet.

check: One ISSS application covers these: two essays (campus involvement and financial need, no AI-written answers) and a K-State faculty or staff recommendation.

k-state-alumni-international-student-sch.who: Degree-seeking international students on the Manhattan, Salina, or Olathe campus.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed Mar 17. No 2027 date posted yet.

check: One ISSS application covers these: two essays (campus involvement and financial need, no AI-written answers) and a K-State faculty or staff recommendation.
You need leadership that has promoted international involvement on campus.

l-evans-roth-graduate-research-award.who: Biology grad students with superior research in cell, molecular, or developmental biology.

deadline.note: Given each year at the Biology Graduate Research Forum. No date posted.

check: Your major professor or committee nominates you with a letter, your CV, and a paragraph on your accomplishments. You present at the forum that year.

john-c-frazier-plant-science-research-aw.who: Biology grad students with superior research in plant science.

deadline.note: Given each year at the Biology Graduate Research Forum. No date posted.

check: Your major professor or committee nominates you with a letter, your CV, and a paragraph on your accomplishments. You present at the forum that year.

christopher-c-smith-evolutionary-biology.who: A Biology doctoral student doing excellent work in evolutionary biology.

deadline.note: Given each year at the Biology Graduate Research Forum. No date posted.

check: Your major professor or committee nominates you with a letter, your CV, and a paragraph on your accomplishments. You present at the forum that year.

chris-edler-award-for-konza-research.who: Biology grad students with superior research and service on Konza Prairie and a strong teaching record.

deadline.note: Given each year at the Biology Graduate Research Forum. No date posted.

check: You must present at the forum at some point in your graduate career.

james-e-ackert-presentation-award.who: Best talk at the Biology Graduate Student Research Forum by a newer student.

deadline.note: Given each year at the Biology Graduate Research Forum. No date posted.

check: Only if you've been in the Biology grad program less than two years.

h-henley-haymaker-presentation-award.who: Best talk at the Biology Graduate Student Research Forum by a more senior student.

deadline.note: Given each year at the Biology Graduate Research Forum. No date posted.

check: Only if you've been in the program two or more years, or already have an MS.

sarachek-scientific-travel-awards.who: Travel money for K-State doctoral candidates whose research uses modern molecular biology methods.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed. The next date isn't posted.

check: You must have passed prelims and reached candidacy.

ift-feeding-tomorrow-graduate-scholarshi.who: Grad students in a food science degree program with a commitment to the field. IFT membership isn't required.

deadline.note: The next cycle opens in January 2027.

check: Grad students must be pursuing a degree in food science, not just doing food-related research.

ift-first-travel-scholarships.who: Money to attend the IFT Annual Meeting and Expo. Open to international students.

deadline.note: The next cycle opens in January 2027.

check: Grad students must be pursuing a degree in food science.

nres-graduate-fellowship.amount: $1,500, plus a separate $500 travel award you can apply for
nres-graduate-fellowship.who: Doctoral students in any discipline whose research is in natural resources, environmental science, or sustainability.

deadline.note: The 2026 round closed Apr 10. The next date isn't posted.

check: You mentor senior undergrads in the NRES capstone class during the fellowship semester. Candidacy is preferred.

gsc-and-mags-graduate-teaching-awards.amount: $500 scholarship; winners go on to the MAGS award ($750)
gsc-and-mags-graduate-teaching-awards.who: Grad students who teach at K-State. One master's and one doctoral nominee per department.

deadline.note: 2026 department nominations closed Sep 29.

check: Your department nominates you, with a head's letter and a teaching portfolio.

k-state-scholarship-network.who: One K-State profile that matches you to donor and department scholarships. Open to incoming, continuing, international, and graduate students.

deadline.note: The 2026 priority deadline for continuing, transfer, international, and grad students was Mar 15. 2027 dates aren't posted.

sdur-research-and-travel-awards.amount: Up to $500 for research, or $200 to $500 for conference travel
sdur-research-and-travel-awards.who: Undergrads doing mentored research in spring 2027, or traveling to a research conference.

deadline.label: noon
deadline.detail: Application and your mentor's letter are both due.

check: You need a letter from your faculty mentor, and you must be enrolled for credit to receive research funds.

hertz-fellowship.amount: $38,000 nine-month stipend plus full tuition equivalent, renewable up to 5 years (up to $250,000 total)
hertz-fellowship.who: Students starting a PhD in the applied physical or biological sciences, mathematics, or engineering.
check: You must be a college senior, a first-year grad student, or in a gap year before grad school. Funding starts fall 2027, and you must be in your first or second PhD year then.
Fellows make a non-binding moral commitment to make their skills available to the U.S. in a national emergency.

charlotte-w-newcombe-doctoral-dissertati.amount: $33,500 for 12 months of dissertation writing; your school is asked to waive tuition and fees
charlotte-w-newcombe-doctoral-dissertati.who: PhD candidates in their final writing year whose dissertation centers on religion, ethics, morals, or values.

deadline.detail: Phase 1 deadline. Recommendation rubrics are due Nov 5.

check: You must be ABD with an approved dissertation proposal by Nov 1, 2026, and expect to finish between April 1 and August 31, 2027.
You cannot have held a similar national award for the final year of dissertation writing.
STEM students can apply only when religion, ethics, or values are central to the dissertation.

graduate-ellison-scholars.amount: Full Oxford course fees and a living stipend, plus travel, a tech setup, and arrival costs
graduate-ellison-scholars.who: Students ready to start a DPhil at Oxford in October 2027, working on an Ellison Institute project.

deadline.detail: Apply to EIT by 5pm UK time. Picked candidates then apply to Oxford between January and March 2027.

check: This funds a new doctorate at Oxford starting October 2027. It does not fund your current program.
EIT gives a GPA of 3.7 of 4 or higher as example evidence, on top of Oxford’s own entry requirements.

humane-studies-fellowship.amount: $2,000 conference grants, $5,000 publication grants, up to $15,000 sabbatical grants
humane-studies-fellowship.who: PhD students and postdocs whose research advances classical liberal scholarship.

deadline.note: Rolling. Decisions within about eight weeks.

check: The main fellowship needs full-time PhD enrollment. The $2,000 conference tier also covers master’s and PhD students who have not reached candidacy.
Preference goes to research tied to IHS focus areas.
